searchText: you could probably solve this issue by using a bot to do bans instead since it can be configured to always delete the messages, but maybe training people to use the bot instead of normal ban is the same difficulty as training them to change the default selection on mobile hello! sorry for the spam, just wanted to quickly check if anyone else is having issues running archive node on goerli? I'm running Besu and I get stuck on 0x441063, which is last istanbul block, without any useful messages in logs. thanks! I recommend asking in the Besu Discord server. You'll probably get a better response. i'm already having discussion there, they just suggested i could ask here in case someone else have same issue (since not a lot of people run full node on goerli) 🙂 Did someone ever workout reliable numbers for the cost of mining 1 ETH pre and post merge? * for mining one block You mean operational costs? Including CapEx? Amortized? Nah just some basic numbers: 32 ETH will get me roughtly n blocks per year, the same investment will give me roughly k block per year in pow > the same investment will give me roughly k block per year in pow does not really work, because miners usually mine through pools you can use https://proposalprobab.web.app/ to calculate the block probability on pos though and with staking, block proposal rewards are only a fraction of total rewards Still this is a number that is relatively easy to compute at least to give an order of magnitude, cost of hash power should be public (say to rent) blocks per hash power as well. Same for PoS, expected blocks per ETH invested, add in proposal rewards in average, And now you have expected block rewards per ETH invested. I do suspect that MEV makes probably a big difference cause in pos you're guaranteed to know in advance when you have several blocks in a row and this opens new doors which channel is the lounge chat? <#692062809701482577> is close enough right I see a <#823588372743323658> channel in the graveyard #party-lounge is the voice channel and it has its own chat now (click the speech bubble next to the channel title) awesome! thank you for that info. was going to see what kind of design I could come up with that could automate something like that and create a simulated network for testing
